diagnosis.what_happened: Aggregate checks masked missing table notes and non-compliant headers. English words were allowed as warnings.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Use of any() and len() > 0 instead of looping over every table.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Iterate every table individually and enforce strict constraints. Escalate English words to FAIL.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Aggregate boolean logic evaluates document-level, not localized constraints.

desired_behavior: Every validation gatekeeper must inspect 100% of tables individually, asserting that every column header conforms to standard APA symbols, every table has a Persian definition note, and zero English words exist in narrative text or table cells.
generalization: Validation logic must use exhaustive per-item iteration and strict gating, avoiding aggregate masking.
